10. Making it yours

personalisation

  • My Preferences — What: personal display settings — a board background (colour, gradient, or your own uploaded image), a header colour, an avatar photo, and which "opening experience" greets you. Who: entirely optional, and entirely yours — these choices are stored locally to your own browser, not shared with teammates. Avatar: upload a small photo (max 200KB) to show as a circular avatar in the header, next to the Account menu — like the board background image, it's stored only on this device and never leaves your browser or gets bundled into a project export.
  • Theme toggle — light or dark, one click, in the header at all times.
  • Opening Experience — What: choose what you land on when the app opens (for instance, List View instead of the board by default on a phone). Revisitable any time from My Preferences.
